Name: Steamy Beans Cafe
Author: Faultyyy
Description:
[b]<Info>[/b]

[b]Adds 5 [/b][b]different[/b][b] types of food/drinks you would find in a coffee shop[/b]

[list]
[*]Starbucks Coffee
[*]Glazed Donut
[*]Chocolate Chip Cookie
[*]Cinnamon Roll
[*]Chocolate Croissant
[/list][b]       ﻿<Disclaimer>[/b]

This is my first time making a mod for Stardew Valley, keep in mind the mod in only on version 1.0.0 (the first version) so in future there will be more food and drink items added into the mod, so there will be a 1.2.0 (an updated version of the mod) to download.
[b]Delete "desktop.ini" it is not need for the mod to work.

Install
[/b]1.Download the Mod
2.Delete [b]"desktop.ini" [/b]which is located inside the mod folder
3.Place[b] "[/b][b][JA] Steamy Beans Cafe"[/b] Into your[b] "mods"[/b] folder

I also have a tumblr where I post updates/news on my mods. Go check it out here : [url=https://faulttyy.tumblr.com/]Fualttyy (tumblr.com)[/url]
